title: PROBHE: Prehabilitation with Botulinum Toxin A in complex hernia: an Italian prospective study on predictive scores of myofascial release.
official: PROBHE: Prehabilitation with Botulinum Toxin A in complex hernia: an Italian prospective study on predictive scores of myofascial release.
summary: Main objective: Investigation if there is a change in RDR, CSI, hernia width, length and width of LM and abdominal cavity volume and diameters after BTA injection in LM of abdominal wall.
conditions: Large hernia width, chronically retracted lateral abdominal wall muscles, and irreducible visceral content in the hernia

interventions.name: Botulinum Toxin Type A 500 units Powder for solution for injection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. •	Participant is willing and able to give informed consent for participation in the trial
2. •	Defect width ≥ 10 cm
3. •	Loss of domain (LoD) ≥ 20% and cosmetic discomfort related to the ventral hernia, are negatively or positively influenced by BTA injections;
4. •	Compliance to follow-up
5. •	Male and female
6. •	Written informed consent to preoperative BTA injection and/or surgery
7. •	Age ≥ 18 years old
8. •	Primary ventral hernia
9. •	Incisional ventral hernia
10. •	RDR < 2
Exclusion criteria:
1. •	Medical or psychiatric conditions that compromises the patient’s ability to give informed consent or comply with the study protocol
2. •	Refuse to give informed consent to preoperative BTA injection and/or surgery
3. •	Personal reasons
4. •	Age < 18 years old
5. •	RDR ≥ 2
6. •	Defect width < 10 cm
7. •	LoD < 20%
8. •	Pregnancy and breastfeeding
9. •	Allergy/Intolerance to BTA
10. •	Neuromuscular disorders and diseases
